_global.knn_eval__KnnEvalQuerySource.description: The source of the query vectors of a kNN evaluation.

size.description: The number of documents to sample, from 1 to 1000.

seed.description: The seed of the sampling, to sample the same documents across requests.

_global.knn_eval__KnnEvalDocsQuerySource.description: Samples the query vectors from the stored documents.

vectors.description: The query vectors, from 1 to 1000 entries with unique identifiers.

_global.knn_eval__KnnEvalVectorsQuerySou.description: Uses the query vectors in the request.

id.description: The identifier of the query, which identifies it in the `failures` of the response.

visit_percentage.description:
The percentage of postings to visit, from 0 to 100.
`0` selects the automatic visit calculation.

num_candidates.description:
The number of nearest neighbor candidates to consider per shard.
It can't be less than `k`, or more than 10000 (9999 with sampling).

rescore_vector.description: The rescoring of the candidates. Only applies to quantized fields.

exact.description:
If `true`, compares every vector at full precision.
Only applies to the `baseline`, requires `allow_exact_baseline`, and can't be combined with other settings.

from.description: How the query vectors were chosen.

visit_percentage.description:
The percentage of postings to visit, from 0 to 100.
`0` selects the automatic visit calculation.

num_candidates.description:
The number of nearest neighbor candidates to consider per shard.
It can't be less than `k`, or more than 10000 (9999 with sampling).

rescore_vector.description: The rescoring of the candidates. Only applies to quantized fields.

exact.description:
If `true`, compares every vector at full precision.
Only applies to the `baseline`, requires `allow_exact_baseline`, and can't be combined with other settings.

rescore_window_capped.description: If `true`, the number of vectors to rescore exceeded the limit of 10000.

quantized_scores.description: If `true`, the hits were not rescored, so their scores are estimates, and no query is excluded from the mean recall.

recall.description: The mean recall of the included queries, or `null` if no query is included.

included_queries.description: The number of queries included in the mean recall.

excluded_queries.description: The number of queries excluded from the mean recall, because the search found a document scoring above the baseline's lowest top `k` score.

took_ms.description: The time the searches took, in milliseconds.

vector_ops.description: The number of vector operations of the searches.
